m2d1vfKfDKA.description:
IF IT FITS IN CART, I'LL BUY IT FOR CHRISTMAS! | Family Fizz

0:00 – If It Fits in the Trolley, I’ll Buy It!  
Georgie and Darren kick off the challenge: anything the kids place into one trolley gets purchased.

1:00 – Diving into the Toy Section  
Karma and Koa rush to explore trucks, cars, and dolls—just about everything excites them.

2:45 – Barbie Car & Monster Trucks  
Large boxes quickly fill up space as the family contemplates how to fit them into the cart.

4:10 – Musical Instruments & Coffee Machines  
Karma checks out a pretend coffee maker while the family adds keyboards and microphones.

5:35 – Plushies & Squish Mallows  
The kids can’t resist soft teddies and novelty squishies—time to squeeze them into the trolley.

7:15 – Arts & Crafts Galore  
They find pottery sets, jewellery kits, painting supplies, and more for imaginative play.

8:50 – Baby & Toddler Toys  
The family remembers to choose items for the littlest ones—colourful wooden toys and rattles.

10:25 – Games & Puzzles  
Sienna spots board games, 3D puzzles, and jigsaw sets for a range of ages.

12:05 – Juggling for Space  
They carefully rearrange items like a real-life Tetris, determined to make them all fit.

13:50 – Final Items & Approaching Checkout  
A few last-minute picks sneak into the cart before heading to pay.

15:30 – Overflowing Trolley at the Register  
Everyone marvels at how packed the cart is and preps to transport it all.

17:20 – Arriving at the Donation Box  
The family explains how they’ll donate every single toy so no child is left out this Christmas.

18:50 – Filling the Toy Bank  
Piece by piece, they empty the trolley, stacking the box high with gifts.

19:40 – Reflecting on Christmas Giving  
Karma and Koa share how it feels to give toys to others, and Georgie wraps up the day’s adventure.

It’s time for Secret Santa again where we have to guess who bought what present for who… with a £250 shopping budget each! 

SECRET SANTA! *£250 BUDGET* | Family Fizz

0:00 – “We’re Playing Secret Santa!”  
The family explains the rules of their Secret Santa game, including the £250 budget and drawing names.

1:10 – Drawing Names from the Santa Hat  
Everyone picks a name in secret, trying to avoid seeing who they got.

2:30 – Off to the Mall  
They arrive at the mall, each carrying a matching “Grinch” gift bag before splitting up to shop.

4:00 – Mia’s Shopping Strategy  
Mia reveals she got Georgie and considers jewellery or a special dress.

5:20 – Sienna’s Shopping Adventure  
Sienna, shopping for Darren, debates between clothes and a more unconventional idea.

6:50 – Darren’s Dilemma  
Darren discovers he got Mia—he’s unsure what a 20-year-old would like and explores various stores.

8:20 – Georgie’s Surprise for Sienna  
Georgie (who picked Sienna) heads into stores like Guess and Ralph Lauren to find teen-friendly gifts.

10:10 – Sneaking Around the Mall  
They keep bumping into each other, trying not to reveal where they’re shopping or for whom.

12:00 – Wrapping Up Purchases  
Everyone finishes shopping within the £250 (or €300) budget and heads to meet at Starbucks.

13:40 – Home for Secret Wrapping  
They devise a plan: each person uses a separate room to wrap, then stealthily places the gift in the recipient’s room.

15:20 – The Big Gift Reveal Begins  
The family gathers, each with a mystery present. Sienna opens her stash of gifts first.

18:00 – Sienna’s Guess Haul  
Sienna finds multiple Guess items—socks, a bag, and jewellery—trying to figure out who bought them.

20:30 – Mia’s Turn: A Dainty Watch  
Mia unwraps a two-tone watch, perfect for her love of mixing metals.

22:00 – Georgie’s Dress & Necklace Combo  
Georgie is thrilled to find a Massimo Dutti dress paired with complementary jewellery.

24:50 – Darren’s Unexpected LEGO  
Darren is surprised with a festive LEGO kit.

27:15 – Who’s the Secret Santa?  
Each person guesses who gave them their gift. Some guesses are right on the money, others are totally off.

29:30 – The Big Reveal  
They disclose who was really shopping for whom, recounting near-misses at the mall and accidental clues.

32:00 – Final Reactions & Thank Yous  
Everyone admires each other’s picks, jokes about “cheating” on the budget, and appreciates the thoughtfulness.

34:15 – Wrapping Up & Merry Christmas!  
The family invites viewers to leave their own guesses in the comments and teases more holiday videos to come.
